name: Wockhardt Ltd
about: Wockhardt is a global pharmaceutical and biotechnology organization engaged in manufacturing finished dosage formulations, injectables, biopharmaceuticals, orals and topicals (creams and ointments). [1]
keyPoints:
Market Position
The company is amongst the top 3 Indian generic companies in the UK and the 6th largest generic supplier in the retail and hospital channels in Ireland. It is the No. 1 Methycobalamin brand in India.  [1]

cons: Stock is trading at 4.52 times its book value
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 1.15% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of -6.96% over last 3 years.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -14.8%
